description: This is a FastAPI-based backend module serving endpoints for health check, travel advice, and demo page for a Clothing Recommendation Service frontend. It manages application startup/shutdown, dependency injection for backend clients, and defines multiple API routes for health, advice retrieval via POST and GET, and a minimal HTML demo.

classes.name: BackendClient
classes.description: Client class to communicate with backend services for fetching travel-related data.

classes.name: TravelAdvice
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the aggregated travel advice response.

classes.name: CityQuery
classes.description: Pydantic model for incoming city query input.

methods.name: lifespan(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Asynccontext manager controlling startup and shutdown behaviors for app-wide resources.

methods.name: BackendClient get_backend_client()
methods.description: Dependency provider for injecting the BackendClient instance into endpoints.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Endpoint to check service health status.

methods.name: TravelAdvice get_travel_advice(body: CityQuery, client: BackendClient = Depends(get_backend_client))
methods.description: Endpoint that accepts a JSON body with a city name and returns aggregated travel advice.

methods.name: TravelAdvice get_travel_advice_q( city: str = Query(..., min_length=1, description="City name."), client: BackendClient = Depends(get_backend_client), )
methods.description: Query parameter variant of the travel advice endpoint.

methods.name: HTMLResponse demo()
methods.description: Serves a simple HTML page for manual testing of the travel advice endpoint.

methods.name: websocket_help()
methods.description: Provides informational message about WebSocket support (not supported currently).
